text:
olivia.marketing: quick ask — we need a tight microcopy pass for the hosted / dedicated / private landing heroes + a CTA routing plan for webinar vs demo vs start. goal: reduce friction for engineers, call out economics. drop line suggestions and CTA pairings by EOD? link: https://rbw.md/hero-microcopy :pray:
maria.copy: for hosted — 'Hosted API — ship LLM features in minutes.' subhead: 'Start with curated models and predictable pricing.'
sam.growth: alternate hosted line: 'Hosted API — fastest way to prototype and scale.'
tariq.ops: for dedicated — 'Dedicated capacity — reserved GPUs, predictable throughput.' subhead: 'SLA-backed performance for production.'
maria.copy: private candidate: 'Private deployment — VPC or on‑prem for regulated workloads.' subhead: 'Customer-managed networking and KMS integrations.'
sam.growth: small benchmark blurbs below hero? e.g. 'Typical gen latency < 60ms for 512 tokens (single-request).' can A/B test visible metric vs value-led line.
ben.salesbot: routing note: webinar signups -> growth queue, demo requests -> AE queue, "Start free" -> onboarding flow. quick rules: `webinar` => growth@, `demo` => sales@, `start` => onboarding@.
tariq.ops: proposed CTA matrix (short):
```
if cta == "Join webinar": route = growth
elif cta == "Request demo": route = sales
elif cta == "Start free": route = onboarding
```
maria.copy: microcopy variants (2 each) — Hosted A: 'Hosted API — start generating today.' Hosted B: 'Hosted API — no infra, just calls.' Dedicated A: 'Dedicated GPUs, predictable latency.' Dedicated B: 'Reserved pools for steady throughput.' Private A: 'Control plane in your VPC.' Private B: 'On‑prem option for air‑gapped environments.'
sam.growth: CTA pairing suggestion: hero primary = product CTA (Start free / Request demo), hero secondary = benchmark or webinar depending on traffic source. paid channels -> Start free; community/webinar promos -> Join webinar.
olivia.marketing: this is gold — next steps: maria finalize copy variants in the doc, tariq confirm exact routing rules + tags for growth funnel, sam set up A/B with benchmarks vs value line for hosted hero. i'll schedule a short copy review wednesday 10am and we'll pick winners before next webinar push. :sparkles:
ben.salesbot: noted. I'll auto-tag leads with `source=hero-cta` and `cta_type` so ops can segment.
maria.copy: added all variants to the doc and included character counts for hero + subhead. ping me if you want punchier tone or more technical hooks.
sam.growth: i'll mock up two hero screenshots for the AB test and add to the doc by EOD.
tariq.ops: routing config ready for review at https://rbw.md/routing-draft — will include fallback: if growth queue backfilled, route webinar -> nurture list.
olivia.marketing: perfect — thanks team! :wave:
